task_instance: Design and implement a small multi-agent system per the skill's core patterns: a supervisor/orchestrator that decomposes a task, routes to two context-isolated specialist agents (researcher, analyzer), aggregates their distilled outputs into a writer agent, and uses the skill's `forward_message` tool to bypass supervisor paraphrasing for the final report (fixing the 'telephone game' problem). Also implemented the peer-to-peer/swarm handoff pattern (explicit transfer_to routing across billing/technical/sales/general agents). Verified with an automated pytest suite covering context isolation, forward_message behavior, worker-cap enforcement, validation-before-downstream-consumption, and handoff routing correctness.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/muratcankoylan__agent-skills-for-context-engineering__multi-agent-patterns . Files produced: multi_agent.py (Supervisor class with decompose/route/run, AgentContext for isolated per-agent state, forward_message tool per skill's exact code pattern, worker_cap gotcha enforced via assertion, and a swarm handle_customer_request/transfer_to handoff pattern taken directly from the skill's Example 2) and test_multi_agent.py (10 pytest cases). Ran `python3 multi_agent.py`: supervisor produced {'type': 'direct_response', 'content': 'Final Report:\n- Researcher findings...\n- Analyzer: n=6, total=108, avg=18.00'} confirming the writer's final output was forwarded directly (not re-paraphrased by the supervisor), and the swarm handoff correctly routed billing/technical/sales/unknown requests to the right agent. Ran `python3 -m pytest test_multi_agent.py -v`: all 10 tests passed, verifying (1) each agent context holds only its own isolated payload, (2) forward_message returns direct_response vs supervisor_input correctly, (3) the writer marks output final so it bypasses synthesis, (4) end-to-end supervisor run forwards the final report and keeps its own trajectory log condensed (2 entries, not full sub-agent contexts), (5) a worker_cap below the number of decomposed subtasks raises an AssertionError (gotcha #1 enforcement), (6) empty-output validation guards against error propagation, and (7) all four swarm handoff request types route to the correct specialist. No credentials, network calls, or MCP/connector tools were needed since the deliverable is architecture/coordination code, not a call to a live LLM API.
